answer: Because each island escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the jetty ledger records every share and the reef audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 5 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 31 aliases means 31 times 5 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 3 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
